name: How long does it take to see results from AI SEO for a law firm?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from AI SEO for a law firm?

acceptedAnswer.text: While some initial improvements in website performance and keyword rankings can be observed within 2-3 months, significant and sustained results from AI SEO typically take 6-12 months. This timeframe allows for search engines to fully re-index optimized content, for AI models to refine strategies based on ongoing data, and for long-term content strategies to mature. Consistency and patience are key, as SEO is a continuous process rather than a one-time fix.
acceptedAnswer.description: Initial AI SEO results for law firms can appear in 2-3 months, but significant and sustained improvements usually take 6-12 months due to ongoing optimization and search engine indexing.
